subject.title: [Bug]: Runtime tool surface returns blank body after gateway-touching operations; container restart only briefly clears it

question: Which owner boundary should own recovery for the session-scoped tool-surface wedge: session lifecycle admission cleanup, gateway restart/compaction fencing, tool invocation/result handling, or an explicit session reset/health API?
rationale: The report now has strong field evidence, but the source inspection does not isolate one repair point and the current labels already block new automated fix PRs until maintainer review.

options.title: Reproduce and isolate before repair
options.body: Use one live reported session or a controlled gateway restart/compact repro to identify the owner path, then repair that boundary with focused regression coverage.

options.title: Treat #99524 as partial only
options.body: Continue reviewing or landing PR #99524 for its prompt-projection case while keeping this issue open for the broader all-tools session wedge.

options.title: Choose a recovery surface first
options.body: If maintainers want product mitigation in parallel, define the sessions reset/tools_status behavior before asking for an implementation.

recommendation.title: Reproduce and isolate before repair
recommendation.body: Use one live reported session or a controlled gateway restart/compact repro to identify the owner path, then repair that boundary with focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete recently merged and authored adjacent session reset/lifecycle work and is the best available routing owner for the cross-gateway/session choice.
